department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants: January 8 for Fall (September) entry (Winter March 15, Summer August 1); rolling review.
deadline.quote: International applicants Term Annual application deadlines Fall (September) January 8 Winter (January) March 15 Summer (May) August 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must get tentative acceptance from an advisor and include their written agreement in the application.
supervisor.quote: Qualification for admission to the PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering program is contingent on first receiving tentative acceptance from an academic advisor who will accept you into their research group.

funding.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

entry_route.value: An MSc in electrical or computer engineering (recommended GPA 3.5) is normally required.
entry_route.quote: you must normally have completed a Master of Science degree in electrical or computer engineering with a recommended minimum GPA of 3.5
